scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); const cleanDir = (dir, isRoot) => { fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).forEach(f => { const p = dir + '/' + f.name; if (f.isDirectory() && f.name !== 'node_modules' && f.name !== 'dist') cleanDir(p, false); else if (!isRoot && /\.(js|d\.ts|map)$/.test(f.name)) fs.unlinkSync(p); else if (isRoot && /^drizzle\.config\.(js|d\.ts|map)$/.test(f.name)) fs.unlinkSync(p); }); }; if (fs.existsSync('src')) cleanDir('src', false); cleanDir('.', true);"
